evidence.note: Signature covers the Response element only
Assertion ID is not referenced by any signature

output.fix: Configure the Entra enterprise app (SAML Signing Certificate > Signing Option) to "Sign SAML response and assertion" so the assertion carries its own signature, then verify that signature against the pinned IdP certificate. Keep the SP requirement for a signed assertion in place. Don't relax it to accept a response-only signature. Make sure the SP validates that the signature Reference URI matches the ID of the assertion it consumes.

alternatives.why_not: The response signature may be valid. The problem is which element is signed, not whether the signature verifies.
